answer: Locks are recorded in fable, expire in comet, and ivory lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 102 aliases as a result needs 123 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4434 identities would post 4656 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
